notes:
- Camera, microphone and screen sharing now ask your permission the way any browser does, and screen sharing works for the first time. Choosing "Block" is no longer permanent: refresh the page and you will be asked again.
- The sign-in screen no longer locks your keyboard. Your organisation's rules now begin when you sign in, not before.
- Typing and scrolling stay smooth throughout a session, and the browser opens noticeably faster.
- The installer is around a third smaller to download.
